posts.body_html:
HI David,

Same exact cross, L x best clone. Doesn't matter which pod or how many pods it comes from, it's all the same cross, and with respect to nomenclature, they're all L x best clone.

I've actually made tons of liberty Co crosses over the years, and most of this was distributed locally (in the SF bay area). Here's one of them: sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/273/flava-var-atropurpurea

posts.body_html:
Look at that color! This is my darkest L x Best seedling. 

As Mike mentioned earlier in the thread these plants don't color optimally with the root stress caused by impure water and they looking a lot redder this year since I switched to RO. Can't wait to see these guys in a couple years as clumps of 10+ 2 foot tall pitchers!

posts.body_html:
Inspired by Mike's select dark clone thread here is another shot of my dark clone I was lucky to snag (same plant as photographed above). One thing I like about this individual is that although the tube is very dark it maintains a red flecked neon green lid. In this case I find the contrast to be more pleasing to my eye than solid red.
This plant bloomed for me this spring, but is a looong way from full vegetative maturity. This pitcher is maybe only 20" tall but I suspect it will produce much larger traps in coming years.
